seo.title: Get Involved
seo.description: Donate, volunteer, or partner with Moca Colombia to create lasting opportunities in La Argentina.

hero.title: Get Involved
hero.statement: Join us in creating lasting opportunities for communities across La Argentina together.
hero.alt: Volunteers working together and sharing supplies

donate.title: Donate
donate.body: Your donation helps expand access to education, nutrition, healthcare, and sustainable livelihoods. Every contribution supports practical initiatives developed around the community's priorities. Together, we can create opportunities that continue making a difference for generations.
donate.alt: Hands supporting a piggy bank while another hand contributes a heart

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.body: Share your time, knowledge, and skills to support meaningful community-led work. Volunteers help strengthen our programs while building genuine connections with the people we serve. Your involvement can turn commitment into measurable and lasting impact.
volunteer.alt: A volunteer educator engaging with students in a classroom

partner.title: Partner With Us
partner.body: We collaborate with organizations, institutions, and businesses that share our commitment to sustainable development. Strategic partnerships provide expertise, resources, and opportunities that strengthen every initiative. By working together, we can expand our reach and build lasting solutions.
partner.alt: Two people joining hands to represent partnership

cta.title: Change a Life Today
cta.body: Whether you donate, volunteer, or partner with us, your support helps strengthen education, healthcare, sustainable livelihoods, and long-term community development.
